name: Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited
summary: Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells wires and cables, and electrical accessories in India and internationally. It operates through Wire and Cables, Lighting & Fittings, and Accessories & Others segments. It provides electrical accessories, including carino, vyoma, and power modular switches, as well as puf and zac switches; and MCBs/isolaters/distributtion boxes, and bells and extension cords. The company also offers wires and cables, such as multi strand cables, L.T. industrial cables, and copper flexible cables; and compact fluorescent lamps and T5 fittings. In addition, it provides ceiling, ventilation, table, wall, and pedestal fans; and pumps, immersion heaters, telephone and co-axial wires, LED bulbs and lights, and other electrical accessories. Further, the company also offers PVC wires, copper conductors, and aluminum and other conductors; electrical lamps, such as vacuum and gas filled lamps, general lighting lamps, luminaries and accessories, etc.; and other appliances. The company markets its products under the VETO and VIMAL POWER brand names through a network of dealers and distributors. Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited was founded in 1967 and is based in Jaipur, India.
